digest.component_or_area: store push and init with S3 remote
propositions: S3 remote operations (init, push) must fail closed with an actionable error if git-remote-s3 helper is missing or below version 0.3.2, preventing store corruption from unlocked pushes
S3 mode is detected by URL scheme (s3:// or s3+zip://) and the preflight guard must raise OptionalDependencyError unconditionally, overriding best-effort push semantics to halt execution early

The preflight helper _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url() is called after URL resolution in push.py (synchronous and async paths) and init.py, reusing existing git remote get-url calls with no new resolution seams
Non-S3 remotes and unresolvable remotes are unaffected; the preflight is a no-op for non-s3:// and non-s3+zip:// schemes, preserving existing best-effort behavior

OptionalDependencyError is re-raised in push_after_commit exception handler to prevent swallowing the deliberate S3 misconfiguration signal, while write_and_push (uncaught) propagates it naturally to abort with the actionable message
